title: The Music of Marie
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: On the island of Pirito, a peaceful society without advanced technology is watched over by Marie, a giant mechanical goddess who floats in the sky and whose music brings harmony. Kai, who alone can hear her music since a childhood incident, grows devoted to her, while his friend Pipi loves him. His search for understanding leads him inside Marie, where he learns the truth about her and his world.
life_message: A harmonious utopia may rest on a hidden cost, and human nature, love and faith must be weighed against it.
